visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Replace margin tricks with flex
visualizerParams.problemDescription: This page centres the box with fixed offsets that only work for one screen size. Use flexbox so it stays centred. The box must stay centred in the card.

solution.explanation: An offset of 120px only centres the box when the card is about 280px wide. Flexbox centres it at any size, with no numbers to recalculate.

checks.label: The box is centred up and down
checks.expr: (() => { var s = el('.card').getBoundingClientRect(), d = el('.box').getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.abs((s.top + s.height / 2) - (d.top + d.height / 2)) < 11; })()
